title: Instruction file, docs skeleton and the local gate
summary: CLAUDE.md under a byte budget, docs/ (conventions, ADR, runbooks), the findings catalogue with a /retro skill that feeds it at the end of a session, and scripts/security-checks.sh running every guard in scripts/guards.d/.

KIT_REPOSITORY.prompt: Repository of the kit (owner/name), where what a session finds in a kit file is reported

postInstall: Fill CLAUDE.md: project overview, architecture map, commands, the sensitive areas under "Before pushing" and the conventions for new code (each gap is a TODO(harness) comment).

Run `git add -A`, then ./scripts/security-checks.sh --offline: several guards read what git tracks, and the gate must pass before the first commit. An instruction file that was already there and has no `harness:budget <bytes>` line turns CM-1 red until one is added.
When a bug or a review finding is fixed, give it an ID: one line in SECURITY_REVIEW.md, one check in scripts/guards.d/50-project.sh.
